title: Alert Rules Management API
content: You can programmatically manage alert rules using the /api/v1/rules endpoint. GET /api/v1/rules returns a list of all configured alert rules. POST /api/v1/rules creates a new alert rule; the request body must contain 'name', 'metric', 'condition' (e.g. gt), 'threshold' (float), and 'actions' (array of notification channel IDs). PUT /api/v1/rules/{id} updates an existing rule, and DELETE /api/v1/rules/{id} removes a rule. Example payload: {'name': 'High CPU', 'metric': 'system.cpu.user', 'condition': 'gt', 'threshold': 90.0, 'actions': ['slack-prod']}. You can also query the alert rule history to trace all past configurations and updates.
